title: LearnOps Moodle web-services allow-list (B4, v1)
description: The Moodle web-services functions LearnOps may call (PRD B4), with the parameters LearnOps sends and, only where a function's name differs on a Moodle version, the replacement name. The rules (service account, token, draft rule, capabilities, lab checks) are in contracts/moodle-ws.v1.md, which is the normative text. libs/moodle_ws builds its allow-list from the example file of this schema, so contract and code cannot drift apart (guide's decision on Q1, PR #27).
$comment: No verification state is stored here: results of the lab checks go to docs/decisions/ (guide's decision on Q1), so any property name containing 'verif' is refused. Unknown fields are otherwise allowed, as in every contract (PRD B.0, EXT-02). NOT expressible here, so checked by libs/contracts/tests/test_moodle_ws_v1.py: function names are unique and equal the PRD B4 list; every listed parameter (required or optional) is named for its function in the PRD B4 parameter table, and no name is in both lists; a replacement name also appears in the PRD B4 text (the guide's rule: change the PRD in the same pull request as the replacement).

function_name.description: A Moodle web-services function name, for example core_course_get_contents. The lookahead is needed because $ also matches before a final newline in Python regular expressions.

purpose.description: The Purpose cell of the PRD B4 table.

parameters.description: Always-sent parameters: LearnOps sends them on every call, including ones that have a default in Moodle (see moodle-ws.v1.md §2). Only names the PRD B4 parameter table gives for this function (taken from the Moodle source; their behaviour is lab check 1 in moodle-ws.v1.md). An empty list means 'not yet determined', never 'no parameters'.

optional_parameters.description: Optional parameters: sent only when needed. Same naming rule as parameters. Absent when the function has none recorded. A name is never in both lists (checked by the contract tests).

replacements.description: Only where the function's name differs on a Moodle version. Absent when the name is the same on 4.5 and 5.3.
